ca9a993417.t: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Marketing & Management leaders imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts — and crafting the narratives that bring those products to the world.

They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking, deep research, and compelling go-to-market storytelling.

They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, marketing, and communications, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

You will be part of the team responsible for product roadmaps and launches at Airbnb. You will drive specific features that are part of every launch and determine how they are positioned and communicated to the external world. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release to growth. And your cross-functional work ensures a consistent product voice across the experiences being built at Airbnb.

We are seeking a Product Marketing & Management leader to join our Tickets team. Tickets is a new and fast-growing business spanning attractions, tours, and live events, and you'll be at the forefront of defining the category for Airbnb — shaping a product guests love, building the supply that powers it, and telling the story that brings it to market. This is an exciting opportunity to stand up a business from the ground up and leave a lasting impact on how the world explores and connects.

· Develop and maintain a product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Airbnb Tickets.

· Synthesize guest, host, and partner feedback and translate it into product features and positioning.

· Develop the public-facing messaging and narrative for Tickets, and land the value proposition with guests, supply partners, and the media.

· Align product teams and cross-functional partners across marketing, communications, and PMM.

· Develop partnerships with attractions operators, tour providers, and live event suppliers, with a focus on both supply and demand.

· Ensure the existing storefront is healthy and the quality bar is high across ticket listings.

· Role model behaviors that encourage open communication and curiosity.

· Make judgements and prioritization decisions that are in the best interests of our users.

· Efficiently execute to ship products and deliver impact for our business and users.

· 10+ years of product management and/or product marketing experience.

· Experience creating product messaging and positioning and delivering it to customers and the media.

· Demonstrated inbound and subject matter expertise, ideally in ticketing, travel, events, or marketplace businesses.

· Background in ticketing marketplaces, including hands-on experience with operator and supply-side tools and with ticketing standard APIs and integrations (e.g., reservation and distribution systems, connectivity platforms, barcode/QR validation).

· Requirements gathering & documentation — framed around turning ambiguous problems into clear specs that align eng, design, and partners.

· Backend ticketing data model — ticket types, fare/price classes, entitlements, and how those relationships structure inventory.

· Inventory & availability modeling — capacity, time slots, holds, and real-time availability across supply sources.

· Able to build compelling customer-focused stories and work with marketing and communications partners to bring them to life.

· Excited to build a new business that brings the best possible ticketing experience to all the guests and hosts on our platform.

· Demonstrated track record of product leadership in a cross-functional environment.

· Built and scaled global consumer products, marketplaces, or ecosystems that people love.

· Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality and leading teams through a dynamic environment.

· Experience working on consumer products that drive significant revenue.

· A strong ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy and go-to-market decisions.

· Excited to drive execution across teams in a fast-paced environment.

· Enjoys doing individual contributor product and product marketing work and staying in the details.

· Strong ability and desire to travel frequently, including domestic and international.

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff, Data Product Manager, GTM Data Science & Analytics.

We are seeking a Staff, Data Product Manager to lead the strategy, development roadmap, and lifecycle of our data products and platforms. In this role, you will work at the intersection of data, technology, and business to unlock the value of data across the organization.

You’ll define the roadmap for data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and ensure data products are scalable, reliable, and user-friendly. Together we’ll turn fragmented, raw data into structured, usable assets that drive decision-making, automation, and personalization across teams.

You’ll ensure the right data is accessible, trustworthy, and actionable to power everything from executive insights to predictive models. You’ll bridge the gap between technical teams who build data infrastructure and business teams who rely on it, aligning data strategy with business goals.

In short, you will turn data into our most valuable asset to drive business growth.

· Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products (e.g., dashboards, data platforms, model features and enhancements, etc) that support data-driven insights, decisioning, and actions.

· Act as the bridge between data engineers, data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into data solutions.

· Develop product requirements and user stories focused on data access, usability, performance, and quality.

· Prioritize data initiatives based on business impact, technical feasibility, and data availability.

· Ensure proper data governance, privacy, and compliance practices are followed.

· Ensure teams have self-service access to GTM data via platforms, tools, and interfaces.

· Monitor and improve data quality, reliability, and user adoption of data tools and features, providing regular reporting on effectiveness and areas for improvement..

· Define and track success metrics for data products, ensuring they meet business and technical goals.

· Foster a culture of data-driven decision making by making data products intuitive and accessible.

· Partner with finance, product, and sales teams to ensure that data products serve the needs of our internal customers.

· Stay informed about industry trends, tools, and best practices in data product management and data enablement.

· Develop training materials to empower teams across the organization to use data effectively for decision-making, campaign execution, and customer engagement.

· Lead initiatives to improve data literacy across teams, ensuring that data is accessible, understandable, and actionable.

· Identify opportunities for innovation in how we leverage data, driving new methodologies and technologies to enhance data utilization and customer experience.

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

· 8 years of experience in product management, engineering, or analytics with a focus on data products, analytics platforms, or data infrastructure, with a preference for direct experience supporting GTM or sales analytics in a SaaS environment.

· Strong understanding of data platforms, data pipelines, and analytics/BI tools (e.g., AWS, Snowflake, DBT, Tableau).

· Proficiency with SQL and familiarity with data modeling concepts.

· Experience working with data teams (engineering, analytics, and data science).

· Knowledge of data governance, privacy regulations, and data security standards.

· Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Experience with agile product development methodologies.

· Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and execute multiple initiatives simultaneously.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies.

· Experience with GTM technology stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, etc)

· Experience with AI products such as Claude, Cortex, Glean, Gemini

· Experience with project management software such as Jira & Airtable

· Knowledge of data governance and data privacy regulations (e.g., MNPI compliance).

· Advanced degree (MBA, Master’s in Engineering, Analytics, Data Management or related fields) is a plus.

Location

Travel

· Drive the strategy and execution for increasing the velocity of experimentation across the ads quality team — designing frameworks that allow the team to test, learn, and iterate faster without sacrificing rigor or integrity.

· Work hands-on with machine learning engineers and ads engineers to translate complex ML model outputs and auction dynamics into clear product requirements, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.

· Define and track the right success metrics for ads quality, navigating tradeoffs between advertiser performance, shopper experience, and marketplace health — and communicating those tradeoffs clearly to senior stakeholders.

· Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where priorities shift, new data surfaces frequently, and the ability to make good decisions under uncertainty is essential to moving the business forward.

· 2+ years of product management experience in online advertising, ad tech, or a closely related domain — with a demonstrated understanding of auction mechanics, bidding systems, or ad quality signals.

· 2+ years of experience working directly with machine learning teams or ML-driven products, with the ability to engage substantively in technical conversations about model design, evaluation, and tradeoffs.

· Proven track record of defining and executing on product roadmaps in complex, data-rich environments with multiple cross-functional stakeholders.

· Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product decisions, measure impact, and design experiments.

· Hands-on familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and how they can be applied within ads or ranking systems.

· Experience working with ads machine learning models in a production environment, including relevance scoring, auction optimization, or quality filtering.

· Prior experience at a retail media network, demand-side platform, or supply-side platform, with exposure to the full advertising stack.

· Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments where structure and process are still being built — and an eagerness to help build them.

Unser Kunde ist ein großer deutscher Dienstleistungskonzern mit einem sehr großen Endkundenstamm und hohem Serviceaufkommen am Telefon. Diesen Service entwickelt er mit KI und Automatisierung konsequent weiter: einfache Anliegen übernimmt zunehmend die Technologie, die Menschen konzentrieren sich auf das Komplexe.

Wir suchen den Kopf, der diese KI-gestützte Contact-Center-Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb aufbaut, ein eigenes Team dafür führt und den telefonischen Kundenservice damit auf die nächste Stufe hebt.
​
Deine Aufgaben
Mit direkter Berichtslinie zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice trägst Du die volle Verantwortung für die Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb, führst ein eigenes interdisziplinäres Team und schlägst die Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und IT. Das beinhaltet im Detail:
Du konzipierst die Lösung und treibst die Automatisierung im telefonischen Service voran.
Du übersetzt die Anforderungen in klare User Stories für Voice- und Chatbots und verantwortest den Backlog.
Du steuerst die Umsetzung Ende zu Ende, mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung von Projektzielen und Budget bis zur Führung eines interdisziplinären, agilen Teams.
Du führst Telefonie, CRM und Bots gemeinsam mit der IT zu einer Plattform zusammen und gestaltest ihr Zusammenspiel.
Du hast den Markt im Blick, entscheidest über den Einsatz neuer Technologien und verantwortest Qualität und Effizienz im Kundenkanal.
​
Dein Profil
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner / Produktmanager an der Schnittstelle von Business und IT im Bereich Voice oder Conversational AI.
Du hast selbst Voicebots, Sprachdialogsysteme oder eine Contact-Center-Automatisierung in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht, gern mit Plattformen wie Cognigy, Genesys, Five9 oder CCAI.
Du kennst den telefonischen Kundenservice aus der Praxis und hast dort Verantwortung getragen.
Du arbeitest agil, User Stories sind für Dich selbstverständlich; Zertifizierungen wie Scrum, PRINCE2 oder PMP sind ein Plus.
Du beherrschst Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1). Die Lösung steuert einen deutschsprachigen Kundenservice und ist ohne dieses Niveau nicht besetzbar.
​
Wir bieten
Eine Plattform, die Du gestaltest, nicht ein bestehendes System, das Du verwaltest.
Verantwortung im Aufbau, mit eigenem Team, eigenem Budget und direktem Draht zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice.
Eine exponierte Rolle, die Service, Produkt und KI verbindet und Dich für die nächste Führungsaufgabe aufstellt.
Ein attraktives, der Verantwortung entsprechendes Vergütungspaket
​
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst Du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach Deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch. Bitte lade aber vorher Deinen CV hoch, damit wir den grundsätzlichen Match einschätzen können.

c2ce4e286a.t: This role sits within APEX (AI Foundations), the team building the platform-level infrastructure behind ServiceNow's enterprise AI strategy. You'll work alongside engineering, data, and applied research partners to make evaluation a durable, compounding advantage.

Agentic AI is only as trustworthy as the evaluation discipline behind it. ServiceNow is building the evaluation methodology, tooling, and closed-loop production system that will define how good is good enough for AI specialists and multi-agent frameworks across the enterprise — and we're looking for the product leader to help own that discipline.

This is a rare chance to build a category-defining evaluation platform from the ground up, at a company where the outcome shapes how every business unit ships AI, not just one team's roadmap.
Why this role matters
Evaluation is the foundational differentiator for enterprise agentic AI. As frontier models commoditize, defensible advantage shifts to the orchestration and quality layer — how reliably an AI specialist performs in a customer's production environment. This role sits at exactly that inflection point:
You set direction in undefined space — there is no existing playbook to inherit, and the discipline you build becomes the standard others build on.
Your impact is horizontal and enterprise-wide by design, driven through influence, tooling, and a Center of Excellence rather than headcount.
You'll be the definitive point of reference for AI specialist quality across the portfolio — deep technical and methodological ownership without the dilution of people management.
Success is visible and concrete: your framework adopted across business units, a closed-loop system demonstrably improving specialists release-over-release, and tooling used self-serve by teams you never directly staffed.
The impact you'll make
Evaluation strategy and framework: Define the end-to-end evaluation methodology across ServiceNow's AI specialist portfolio — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge calibration, failure taxonomy, and a multi-layer metric model spanning agent behavior, user experience, and business impact.
Closed-loop evaluation platform: Move evaluation from a one-time release gate to a continuous improvement engine, where production telemetry feeds failure analysis, targeted evaluation expansion, and redeployment — making live signal, not synthetic testing, the primary driver of quality.
Cross-functional influence at scale: Partner with a federated Center of Excellence model — central methodology and tooling, embedded practice in each business unit — acting as the internal consulting function that helps teams stand up evaluation without rebuilding infrastructure from scratch.
Platform and tooling: Drive evaluation from bespoke effort to reusable, self-serve platform capability — evaluation infrastructure, data tooling, and calibration systems that make closed-loop evaluation available to every team building AI specialists.
What Success Looks Like
Your evaluation framework is adopted across multiple business units.
The closed-loop platform demonstrably drives specialist improvement release-over-release, sourced from real production signal.
Evaluation tooling is used self-serve by teams the Center of Excellence never directly staffed.
Your quality bar becomes the internally recognized authoritative standard for AI specialist readiness.
12+ years of software product management experience
Deep experience in AI/ML product management, ideally with hands-on exposure to LLM evaluation, agentic systems, or applied ML quality frameworks.
A track record of defining methodology or standards in ambiguous, cross-team problem spaces — not just executing an existing roadmap.
Strong technical fluency — comfortable in the details of evaluation pipelines, data platforms, and production telemetry, not just the product narrative around them.
Proven ability to drive outcomes through influence and technical credibility, without formal authority over the teams you're working with.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.
Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match.

It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching.

We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. This role requires a strategic builder who can operate without a pre-existing playbook. You will make consequential prioritization decisions, turn ambiguous opportunities into a coherent roadmap, and lead across Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Product Marketing, Search Engine Optimization, Brand, and Growth. Your success will be measured by the outcomes the web experience creates, not by the volume of pages launched or requests completed.

· Set the web product vision and roadmap. Define the long-term strategy for postman.com and related web properties. Establish how our web surfaces work together as a portfolio, which audiences and jobs they serve, and where we should invest to create the greatest customer and business value.

· Expand product discovery and top-of-funnel reach. Create new ways for people to discover Postman's full product suite, capabilities, use cases, and solutions. Identify underserved audiences and high-potential entry points, then turn them into intuitive, scalable web experiences.

· Own the most important web journeys. Map and improve the end-to-end paths from first visit through evaluation and entry into the product. Reduce friction, clarify value, and ensure the handoff between the public web experience and the authenticated product feels coherent.

· Build a trusted analytics and attribution foundation. Partner with Data and Engineering to define instrumentation, event taxonomy, source and campaign attribution, identity stitching, funnel reporting, and decision-quality dashboards. Ensure we can understand what is working, for whom, and why.

· Lead privacy-aware measurement. Have a strong point of view on first-party and third-party cookies, consent management, browser restrictions, data retention, and regional privacy requirements. Balance measurement quality, user trust, and compliance when making product decisions.

· Make technical search optimization a product capability. Own the product strategy for technical search (agent) engine optimization, including site architecture, crawlability, indexation, rendering, structured data, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and large-scale content or domain migrations.

· Raise the bar for web performance and quality. Set clear standards for page speed, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, reliability, responsiveness, and cross-browser behavior. Work with Design and Engineering to make craft and performance reinforcing rather than competing priorities.

· Lead through influence. Bring together senior partners across Product, Marketing, Design, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Search Engine Optimization. Communicate strategy, decisions, results, and learning to executive audiences with clarity and conviction.

· Build for a global audience. Develop a thoughtful approach to internationalization and localization so that Postman's web experiences can perform across markets, languages, and regional customer needs.

Your foundation is product management. You bring enough fluency across growth, marketing, design, analytics, privacy, and web engineering to lead effectively at the seams, but you have built your career by owning products and outcomes.

· Staff-level product leadership. You have 8+ years of product management experience, including significant ownership of customer-facing web products or digital experiences at scale. You have set strategy, built roadmaps, and delivered measurable results in complex organizations.

· Demonstrated outcome ownership. You can point to web experiences you personally led that materially changed customer behavior or business performance. You explain the problem, strategic choices, tradeoffs, shipped solution, measurement approach, and resulting impact.

· Deep web product expertise. You understand how modern websites are designed, built, rendered, served, measured, and evolved. You can partner credibly on content management systems, front-end architecture, server-side and client-side rendering, content delivery networks, release workflows, and technical dependencies.

· Strong technical search and agentic optimization fluency . You have hands-on experience using information architecture and technical search engine optimization and AEO to improve discovery at scale. You understand the implications of URL design, site hierarchy, internal linking, structured data, crawl budgets, rendering, redirects, canonicalization, and indexation.

· Web performance expertise. You understand page performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and reliability as product concerns. You know how performance affects discovery, experience, and outcomes, and can make informed tradeoffs with Engineering and Design.

· Measurement, cookies, and attribution fluency. You understand browser and cookie behavior, consent management, first-party data, anonymous and authenticated identity, tag management, attribution limitations, and privacy-aware analytics. You can diagnose gaps in measurement rather than treating dashboards as ground truth.

· Experimentation and quantitative judgment. You are fluent in funnel analysis, experiment design, guardrail metrics, statistical interpretation, and post-launch learning. You know when to test, when not to test, and how to connect a program of experiments to a larger product strategy.

· Exceptional product judgment. You can move between long-term strategy and detailed execution, identify the few decisions that matter most, and balance customer value, business value, technical complexity, brand craft, and speed.

Own end-to-end product responsibility for your area — strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery, adoption, measurable customer and platform outcomes.

Engage engineering as a technical peer — debate API design, reason about system trade-offs, judge the quality of platform internals, and push back when the design is wrong.
Define and own success metrics — what you ship is measured by what changed for the customer or the platform, not by the size of the spec.

6+ years in Product Management, Platform PM, Infrastructure PM, or SRE / Engineering Lead with strong product instincts.

Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable customer or platform impact — quantitative results, not aspirational bullets.
Strong analytical skills: comfort defining and instrumenting product metrics, working with telemetry, building data-informed roadmaps.
Experience leading discovery-heavy work — structured customer interviews, usage analytics, support-ticket analysis — and turning insights into shipped product.
Strong communication and ability to align engineering, SRE, customer-facing teams, and exec stakeholders.
High ownership, bias to ship, comfort with messy operational reality, and the instinct to push back on engineering when the customer experience or platform quality would suffer.

Direct PM experience with frontier AI customers — ML platform teams, MLOps engineers, training and inference at scale.

Direct experience with NVIDIA reference architectures (NVL72, SuperPOD, MGX, DGX) and the NVIDIA stack (drivers, CUDA, NCCL, DCGM).
Familiarity with InfiniBand / RoCE fabrics, firmware lifecycle, topology-aware scheduling.

Background in Kubernetes lifecycle (CAPI, cluster upgrades, node-pool management) or Slurm at scale.

This is a business-side role — you won't be writing code — but you need to understand PRM deeply enough to translate partner and internal stakeholder needs into a clear product vision, a prioritized roadmap, and requirements engineering can build against.

You'll report to the VP of Partner Strategic Operations and work as the connective tissue between the partner organization (Sales Plays & Offerings, Programs, Enablement, Digital Process & AI Operations) and the engineering/IT teams who build and maintain the platform.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Palo Alto for our hybrid working model.

Own the vision and strategy

· Define and own the long-term business vision and strategy for the PRM platform, anchored in the needs of partners and internal partner-organization stakeholders.

· Build and maintain a prioritized product roadmap that balances competing demands from Sales Plays & Offerings, Programs, Enablement, Digital Process & AI Operations, and field/partner-facing teams.

· Stay current on PRM market direction (Salesforce PRM, Impartner, Workspan, Zift, Crossbeam, and emerging AI-native entrants) to inform build-vs-buy and platform evolution decisions.

· Run structured discovery with stakeholders across the partner organization to surface needs, pain points, and opportunities, and translate them into clear, prioritized requirements.

· Author business requirements documents (BRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and IT can build against without ambiguity.

· Maintain and groom the product backlog, balancing new capability requests against platform stability, data quality, and technical debt considerations raised by engineering.

Work cross-functionally to deliver

· Act as the primary business-side liaison to Engineering/IT and any implementation partners or vendors, ensuring business intent survives translation into technical delivery.

· Partner closely with the Digital Process & AI Operations lead to align on which PRM capabilities should be built as native platform features versus automations layered on top.

· Lead or participate in UAT (user acceptance testing) cycles to confirm delivered functionality meets business requirements before release.

· Drive change management and adoption for new PRM capabilities — communication, training materials, and enablement content in partnership with the Enablement team.

Measure and iterate

· Define and track adoption and health metrics for the PRM platform (partner activation, feature adoption, ticket/escalation volume, NPS or satisfaction where available).

· Report platform performance and roadmap progress to the VP of Partner Strategic Operations and other partner-organization stakeholders on a regular cadence.

· Continuously reprioritize the roadmap based on usage data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving partner-ecosystem strategy.

· 8+ years of experience in product management, business systems, or business analysis roles, ideally with direct exposure to PRM, CRM, or other partner/channel technology platforms at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure/data company.

· Familiarity with how AI is being applied to PRM and partner ecosystem tooling (e.g., AI-assisted deal registration, partner health scoring).

· Background in cloud infrastructure, database, or developer-focused technology markets.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

· A clearly articulated, leadership-endorsed vision and roadmap for the PRM platform.

· A well-groomed backlog of BRDs and user stories that engineering can execute against with minimal rework.

· A track record of successful releases, each validated through UAT and adopted smoothly by partner-organization teams and partners themselves.

· Established reporting on platform health and adoption that leadership uses to make ongoing investment decisions.

Job Description
At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further.

You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes
Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.
Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
Owning paid visibility and growth products
Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
Working data-first
Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.
Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.
Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.
Operating as an AI-native Product Manager
Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and AI prototyping tools daily to accelerate discovery, prototyping, PRD creation, and execution.
Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.
Collaborating across teams
Work closely with Customer Success, Patient Marketing, Engineering, Data, Design, and country teams to deliver impact across markets.
Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.
Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.
What will set you up for success in this role?
Core Product Management experience
5+ years of Product Managemen t experience building digital consumer or marketplace products .
Strong product thinking and a user-centric mindset, paired with the commercial instinct to connect product decisions to business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across both commercial and technical audiences.
Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and Data teams.
Extreme ownership, comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping products in emerging spaces.
Exceptionally data-driven
Fluent with SQL and comfortable querying large datasets to explore, size, and validate opportunities independently.
Proven ability to translate business logic into ranking, scoring, or matching logic – and to reason clearly about the trade-offs.
Strong analytical and experimentation skills; you make decisions from data and can defend them.
Deep understanding of customer economics
Strong grasp of the metrics that drive a subscription marketplace: churn, retention, engagement, activation, ARPU, and lifetime value.
Experience owning or moving retention and engagement metrics for a customer base, not just shipping features.

b98983a604.t: Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 7M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Marketplace to join our Product Team to lead our marketplace and integration surfaces.
The marketplace is the two-sided surface of the Supabase ecosystem. On one side, Partners and developers build integrations on top of Supabase primitives like Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions, then publish them for the world to use. On the other, our developers come to discover new capabilities and wire them into their projects without leaving their workflow. Done well, it is the shortest path between a developer with a problem and the exact capability that solves it.
That surface is about to matter more than ever. As the number of capabilities explodes, and as agents begin to assemble software on a developer's behalf, the marketplace becomes the distribution and discovery layer for the whole ecosystem: how both developers and, increasingly, their agents find, trust, and compose what they need. This role owns it.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the marketplace, the two-sided surface where Partners and developers publish integrations and where Supabase's developer customers discover and install them.
Make it effortless for a developer to find the right capability and integrate it. Own discovery, search, listings, and the whole path from install to working integration, so a new capability connects to Supabase primitives and runs inside a developer's project with minimal glue code.
Make publishing an integration fast and rewarding, so Partners and developers bring their best work to the marketplace and keep it current, and so the catalog stays deep where developers need it.
Set the quality bar and the listing standards, and build the review, guardrail, and versioning mechanisms, with Engineering and our Partnerships team, that keep the catalog trustworthy as it scales.
Own what a healthy marketplace looks like: define the metrics across both supply and demand, instrument the surface end to end, and let the signal rather than opinion drive what gets built next.
Position the marketplace as the distribution layer for agent-driven development, where capabilities get discovered and composed on a builder's behalf rather than browsed and installed by hand.

b98983a604.h: You might be a good fit if you
b98983a604.t:
Have 7+ years of product management on developer tools or marketplaces , or are an ex-founder with strong product instincts, and can identify which partners and integrations will matter most, with particular instinct for the agentic and code-first integrations now defining how developers build.
Have built and grown a two-sided surface: an app store, a plugin or integration ecosystem, a developer platform, or a marketplace, and understand the chicken-and-egg of balancing supply and demand, recruiting developers, driving listing quality, and making discovery and install effortless for the consuming side. Experience with app stores or developer-platform distribution is a strong plus.
Are biased toward speed , and would rather ship something imperfect and learn than spend another sprint polishing a spec.
Build with what you own, using the marketplace from both sides: publishing a test integration the way a Partner would, and sourcing and wiring one into a project the way a developer would. You form opinions through first-hand use.
Use AI tools to compress the slow parts of the job, like research, drafting, and synthesising feedback, so you spend more time on judgment calls.
Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote, so you make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

Our mission is to democratize high-performance advertising by enabling brands to achieve world-class results with minimal friction. To achieve this, we need an incredibly robust, scalable, and state-of-the-art Machine Learning infrastructure.

The Ads ML Platform team is at the core of this mission, tasked with building the foundation that powers all of our content understanding, ad targeting, and ad ranking models. We are empowering our ML engineers and data scientists to move faster and build smarter.

As the Senior Product Manager for the Ads ML Platform, you will hold significant ownership over the infrastructure and tools that make our ads marketplace intelligent. You will define the vision and build the roadmap for a platform that enables unparalleled engineering velocity and supports the most modern ML architectures.
You will be the bridge between complex ML systems and business outcomes. If you are passionate about the intersection of platform engineering and state-of-the-art ML research, this is the role for you.
